pe_ratio.unavailable_reason: A P/E ratio cannot be meaningfully calculated when trailing earnings are negative (net loss) or when certified filings are pending.

roe_percent.denominator_definition: Average owner net worth (beginning + ending equity / 2)
roe_percent.scope_policy: Consolidated preferred; standalone explicitly labelled when consolidated unavailable
roe_percent.negative_equity_policy: When net worth is negative, ratio is mathematically non-meaningful and rendered as '—' with certified reason NEGATIVE_EQUITY.
roe_percent.unavailable_reason: ROE cannot be calculated when net worth / shareholders' equity is negative, when owner profit attribution is unsupported, or when comparative balance sheets are incomplete.

range_52w_position.history_basis_policy: Full 52W rolling window (>=252 sessions) OR Available History (<252 sessions for new listings). When history is short, explicitly label the available session count without padding.
range_52w_position.unavailable_reason: Price range position requires valid continuous trading sessions on the canonical series.

profit_vs_cfo.numerator_definition: Trailing 12-Month Net Profit / Profit After Tax (PAT)
profit_vs_cfo.denominator_definition: Annual / TTM Cash Flow from Operations (CFO)
profit_vs_cfo.scope_policy: Strict period and scope parity required (PAT_PERIOD == CFO_PERIOD and PAT_SCOPE == CFO_SCOPE). Never combine standalone profit with consolidated cash flow.
profit_vs_cfo.unavailable_reason: Operating cash flow is pending Gold layer ingestion for the matching period and consolidation scope. Zero is never fabricated.
profit_vs_cfo.fcf_integration_status: FCF live integration: NOT ENABLED until governed source contract exists.

eps_basic_ttm.denominator_definition: Weighted average number of equity shares outstanding during each reporting period (Ind AS 33 / AS 20)
eps_basic_ttm.period_type: Trailing 12 Months (TTM, sum of 4 rolling quarters)
eps_basic_ttm.scope_policy: Consolidated preferred; standalone used where consolidated unavailable
eps_basic_ttm.pe_consistency: Matches exact denominator EPS used by Valuation Gold Engine for P/E computation
eps_basic_ttm.negative_earnings_policy: Negative EPS indicates accounting net loss per share; preserved with negative sign, never coerced to 0 or unavailable
eps_basic_ttm.unavailable_reason: EPS is unavailable when quarterly statutory filings are incomplete or company has fewer than 4 sequential quarters of reported history.

profit_pat.numerator_definition: Total Revenue minus all operating expenses, depreciation, interest, and statutory income taxes
profit_pat.period_type: Trailing 12 Months (TTM, sum of 4 rolling quarters)
profit_pat.scope_policy: Consolidated preferred; standalone used where consolidated unavailable
profit_pat.revenue_pairing_policy: Strict period and scope parity required (REVENUE_PERIOD == PAT_PERIOD and REVENUE_SCOPE == PAT_SCOPE)
profit_pat.negative_profit_policy: Negative PAT indicates accounting net loss; preserved with negative sign, never coerced to 0 or unavailable
profit_pat.unavailable_reason: Profit is unavailable when statutory quarterly filings are incomplete or company has fewer than 4 sequential quarters of reported history.

volume_surge.unavailable_reason: Volume multiple is unavailable when baseline trading sessions are insufficient or the security has experienced trade halts.
volume_surge.computation_note: Ratio of current session volume relative to the 20-session average volume.

revenue_ttm.numerator_definition: Amount recognized from selling products or providing services during the reporting period, before deducting expenses
revenue_ttm.period_type: Trailing 12 Months (TTM, sum of 4 rolling quarters)
revenue_ttm.scope_policy: Consolidated preferred; standalone used where consolidated unavailable
revenue_ttm.pat_pairing_policy: Strict period and scope parity required (REVENUE_PERIOD == PAT_PERIOD and REVENUE_SCOPE == PAT_SCOPE)
revenue_ttm.negative_revenue_policy: The governed Stockerboard contract contains a negative published Revenue value for this case. Learn preserves the published value rather than coercing it to zero or hiding it.
revenue_ttm.unavailable_reason: Revenue is unavailable when statutory quarterly filings are incomplete or company has fewer than 4 sequential quarters of reported history.

market_cap.unit_policy: ₹ INR in Gold Engine, displayed as ₹ Cr (market_cap_crore) in public dossiers and Learn
market_cap.corporate_action_policy: Preserved via governed Share Ledger corporate-action tracking; never adjusted independently in Learn
market_cap.zero_policy: MARKET_CAP = 0 is not a valid published state under VALUATION_GOLD_V1.0.0; both price and shares must be strictly positive (price > 0, shares > 0). Non-positive states fail closed to UNAVAILABLE with —.
market_cap.negative_policy: Fail closed (UNAVAILABLE / NON_POSITIVE_PRICE / INVALID_SHARE_COUNT / NON_POSITIVE_MARKET_CAP); never fabricate non-positive market cap
market_cap.learn_calculation_authority: NO - Learn renders published snapshot value strictly read-only without dynamic production recalculation
market_cap.unavailable_reason: Market Cap is unavailable when price or share ledger state is missing or invalid.

share_price.price_policy: Canonical NSE EOD closing value used by Stockerboard's governed data contract; not intraday real-time price
share_price.adjustment_policy: Session close from OHLC series; corporate actions tracked via Share Ledger
share_price.non_positive_policy: Fail closed (UNAVAILABLE / NON_POSITIVE_PRICE); normal equity prices must be strictly positive (price > 0)
share_price.learn_calculation_authority: NO - Learn renders published snapshot value strictly read-only without dynamic production recalculation
share_price.unavailable_reason: Share Price is unavailable when trading session data is missing or invalid.

stock_ownership.unavailable_reason: Price snapshot is unavailable when trading session data is missing.
